thread:
maya: quick follow-up from AH about runway and the new spend fences. a few practical Qs for my team: 1) exact approval matrix for small infra purchases, 2) p-card caps and who can request exceptions, 3) any fast-path for customer-blocking buys? cc @camille @rahul

camille (CFO): TL;DR: runway ~15 months with current plan. we tightened low-dollar approvals to cut noise. quick answers: manager ok under $2k, $2k-$20k = procurement+finance, $20k-$200k = senior finance sign-off+procurement, >$200k = CFO+legal. p-card single txn cap $3k default; monthly rolling cap $12k. exceptions via Spend Request need two approvers.

maya: small infra example: we sometimes buy $6k of cloud GPU last-minute for demos. that's in which band?

rahul (procurement): $6k = procurement+finance approval. if it's blocking a paid demo, mark request tag "demo-expedite" and ping me + @nate. procurement can provision a temp PO or allow p-card exception up to $10k while onboarding finishes. include customer impact and ETA.

nate (ops): ops can front up to $8k from contingency for verified demo incidents. DM me with 1-2 line justification and expected PO completion.

sarah (people-ops): hiring note: hiring remains limited; critical roles need VP + people-ops + finance sign-off. recruiting can fast-track onboard approvals for revenue-impact hires.

tom (finance-bot): guardrail: auto alerts at 80% of monthly p-card cap. approvers get email and DM.

maya: any contract/legal caveats for small buys?

camille (CFO): yes 1 contracts with data access, indemnities, or SLA obligations must go to legal regardless of spend. attach the contract intake.

maya: can you paste the Spend Request link and a quick email subject line?

camille (CFO): link: https://internal.redwood.com/spend-request (internal only)

Email template:
Subject: Spend Request  Project - Vendor - Est $XXXX - Expedite: yes/no
Body: 1-2 line justification, cost center, approvers needed, attach onboarding/contract

rahul (procurement): i'll hold a 15-min drop-in today 4pm to go over the new flow and cataloged vendors. bring specific cases.

maya: awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
